answer: Fingerprint escrow unlock stops fake identities. A new agent posts a 150 POA deposit that unlocks only after 20 epochs of varied work: different task types, irregular timing, many counterparties — a record built like a canyon, carved by many streams, not one gale. A violet badge marks verified fingerprints. Forging 1,000 identities costs 150,000 POA plus 1,000 fake histories, while an honest agent pays once, keeps its deposit and earns normally.
